claim: SAMEXAP7's effect-vector table dispatches APPEAR START at APST: JMP APST 'APPEAR START' — the materialize lifecycle entry (df4-2 startAppear).
The next effect vector dispatches EXPLOSION START at EXST: JMP EXST 'EXPLOSION START' — the explode lifecycle entry (df4-2 startExplode).
APST seeds the APPEAR animation counter to a NEGATIVE size: LDD #$AF00 (bit 15 set) then STD RSIZE,Y — the ROM's tag for an appear (EXPU BMI). df4-2 APPEAR_INIT_SIZE.
EXST seeds the EXPLODE animation counter to a POSITIVE size: LDD #$100 then STD RSIZE,Y — the ROM's tag for an explosion. df4-2 EXPLODE_INIT_SIZE.
EXPU grows an explosion by $AA each frame: ADDD #$AA 'INCREASE SIZE'. df4-2 EXPLODE_GROW.
The explosion is finished once the size's HIGH byte exceeds $30: CMPA #$30 'CHECK IF FINISHED' (followed by BLS to continue). df4-2 EXPLODE_DONE_HI — done when (size>>8) > $30.
EXPU shrinks an appear by $100 each frame: SUBD #$100 'DECREASE SIZE' (labelled EXPU4); the appear finishes when the value goes non-negative (BPL). df4-2 APPEAR_STEP.

The terrain-explosion strobe is triggered by NEWP TERBLO,STYPE 'BLOW UP TERRAIN' — the full-frame flash df4-2 substitutes with a non-strobing particle burst under ADR-0005 (presentation only; trigger ported).
